text:
Priya: quick note from onboarding calls: users hit vague errors and leave frustrated. python returns a generic Exception with 'request failed' while JS emits a typed RateLimitError. Can we pick one clear contract?
Diego: saw this in support too. customer couldn't tell if 502 was transient or their payload. we should include retryability and a short remediation hint in the message.
Anika: proposal: error contract = (1) native error subclass (AuthError/RateLimitError/NotFoundError/TimeoutError/ServerError/StreamError), (2) stable machine code string, (3) retryable boolean, (4) request_id, (5) hint_url.
Ben: mapping sketch:
```
401 -> AuthError(code="invalid_credentials", retryable=false)
403 -> PermissionError(code="access_denied", retryable=false)
404 -> NotFoundError(code="model_missing", retryable=false)
408/504 -> TimeoutError(code="upstream_timeout", retryable=true)
429 -> RateLimitError(code="rate_limit", retryable=true, retry_after=secs)
5xx -> ServerError(code="internal", retryable=true)
stream: chunk -> StreamError(code="chunk_fail", recoverable=true, offset=tok_idx)
```
Priya: important UX rule: user-facing message = one short sentence + one clear next step + paren with code + request_id. e.g., "Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 12s or reduce concurrency. (code=rate_limit, request_id=abc123)"
Diego: implementation detail: throw native Error subclass but attach envelope fields on the instance (error.code, error.retryable, error.hint_url, error.meta). keeps language idioms intact.
Anika: docs action: add a "Handling errors" snippet to quickstart showing try/catch examples in python + ts and a streaming example showing StreamError.resume.
Ben: CI: add a lint/test that asserts every error has code + retryable + request_id. Also record error.code in telemetry.
Priya: ops: ci-bot create task to track SDK parity work please.
ci-bot: Created ticket RFC-3120: "SDK error surface: classes + codes + docs" assigned to @diego, @anika, due 2026-05-01.
Diego: I'll prototype the runtime mapping (http -> code) and a small enum in both SDKs.
Priya: also standardize language in messages to avoid blame. Replace vague phrasing like 'invalid request' with specific guidance.
Anika: i'll draft copy and add to quickstart. Keep examples minimal.
Ben: don't forget to include request_id in error output and logs; it's critical for support lookups.
Priya: thanks all. small structured change should cut support back-and-forth a lot. :thumbsup:
